[LCSP.6.5] **LIVE enforcement skipped.** All LIVE-state checks — the
`pump_wcet_ns` cap and per-pump WCET ([RTCT.12]), and the RT violation
codes ([NERR.18]) — apply only under `realtime: true`. An engine
with `constspace: true` and `realtime: false` does not transition through the INIT/LIVE
lifecycle and never raises a LIVE-state violation.
